name: cache_i_clean_invalidate_all
notes: I-cache entry of 0xc0c1800 (the R0==0 branch): LDR R3,=0x07FFA000 then the shared body, which takes the clean/invalidate-all command at +0x38 when the controller is already enabled and otherwise invalidates at +0x4 and enables it. Callers must confirm bit0 of both controller words first so the enable branch is never taken. BES cache controller bases are 0x07ffa000 (I) and 0x07ffc000 (D). This is a branch entry inside a larger routine, chosen so the leaf establishes its own arguments; it clobbers only r0/r2/r3 and returns 0. The shipped Lua bootstrap fingerprints these instructions and their PC-relative literals on-device before entering them (scripts/build_band11_installer.py). Independently recovered for the native static test ABI; device NOT_PROBED. No general SDK callable approval.
